core_obligations: Reformulate through a presentation: choose a smooth surjective morphism from a scheme onto the target and use the base change formula for the diagonal together with the covering criterion to reduce every diagonal property to the presenting morphism of algebraic spaces (proof lines 463-481)

The three equivalences: the corresponding statement for algebraic spaces applied to the presenting morphism gives the equivalence of the diagonal being a closed immersion, universally closed or proper (proof lines 482-485)
(1) implies (2): separatedness of the morphism makes the presenting morphism separated, so its diagonal is a closed immersion (proof lines 486-487)

(2) implies (1): for an arbitrary base change of the morphism along a morphism from a scheme, the diagonal is the base change of the original diagonal, so assumption (2) makes it a closed immersion and hence makes the base-changed morphism of algebraic spaces separated (proof lines 488-495)
proof_roadmap: 取 V → Y 满光滑，令 U = X ×_Y V（由可表示性这是代数空间）。
由 Δ 的基变换公式与「沿满光滑覆盖检验性质」的判据，Δ_f 有性质 P ⟺ Δ_{U/V} 有性质 P。
(2)(3)(4) 的等价由代数空间层面（分离 ⟺ Δ 闭浸入 ⟺ Δ 一致闭 ⟺ Δ proper）得到。
(1)⇒(2)：U → V 分离 ⇒ Δ_{U/V} 闭浸入；(2)⇒(1)：任取 T → Y，Δ_{T'/T} 是 Δ_f 的基变换 ⇒ 闭浸入 ⇒ T' → T 分离。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for a morphism of algebraic stacks representable by algebraic spaces, separatedness and the three diagonal conditions (closed immersion, universally closed, proper) are equivalent (author lemma at source lines 451-461, label lemma-representable-separated-diagonal-closed). The proof (source lines 463-496) presents the morphism by algebraic spaces, uses the base change formula for the diagonal and the covering criterion to move every condition to the presentation, applies the corresponding equivalence for algebraic spaces, and closes the circle by identifying the diagonal of an arbitrary base change with a base change of the diagonal (proof lines 463-495). The reduction through the presentation and the two implications are the content. H3.
